heading: Tier2資本の額
text_ja: 第二条第三号の算式において、Tier2資本に係る基礎項目の額は、次に掲げる額の合計額とする。ただし、Tier2資本調達手段のうち償還期限の定めがあり、かつ、当該償還期限までの期間が五年以内になったものについては、連結貸借対照表計上額に、算出基準日から当該償還期限までの期間の日数を当該償還期限までの期間が五年になった日から当該償還期限までの期間の日数で除して得た割合を乗じて得た額とする。一Tier2資本調達手段に係る株主資本の額(社外流出予定額を除く。)二Tier2資本調達手段に係る負債の額二の二Tier2資本調達手段に係る株式引受権の額三Tier2資本調達手段に係る新株予約権の額四特別目的会社等の発行するTier2資本調達手段の額五Tier2資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額六次に掲げる額の合計額イ一般貸倒引当金(内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社においては第百二十七条の規定により標準的手法により算出される信用リスク・アセットの額に対応するものとして区分された一般貸倒引当金及び証券化エクスポージャーに係る一般貸倒引当金に限る。)の額(当該額が第二条各号の算式における信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額(内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社にあっては、第百二十八条第二号に掲げる額及び証券化エクスポージャーに係る信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額とする。)に一・二五パーセントを乗じて得た額を上回る場合にあっては、当該乗じて得た額とする。)ロ内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社において、適格引当金の合計額が事業法人等向けエクスポージャー及びリテール向けエクスポージャーの期待損失額の合計額を上回る場合における当該適格引当金の合計額から当該期待損失額の合計額を控除した額(当該額が第百二十八条第一号に掲げる額に〇・六パーセントを乗じて得た額を上回る場合にあっては、当該乗じて得た額とする。)
text_en: In the formula of Article 2, item (iii), the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital shall be the sum of the following amounts; provided, however, that with respect to Tier 2 Capital instruments that have a maturity date and whose remaining period until such maturity date has become five years or less, the amount shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the amount recorded on the consolidated balance sheet by the ratio obtained by dividing the number of days in the period from the calculation reference date to such maturity date by the number of days in the period from the date on which five years remained until such maturity date to such maturity date. (i) The amount of shareholders' equity relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments (excluding planned external outflows). (ii) The amount of liabilities relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (ii-2) The amount of share subscription rights relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iii) The amount of share options relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iv) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc. (v) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital. (vi) The sum of the following amounts: (a) The amount of general allowances for loan losses (in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, limited to general allowances for loan losses allocated as corresponding to credit risk-weighted asset amounts calculated using the standardized approach pursuant to Article 127, and general allowances for loan losses relating to securitization exposures) (where such amount exceeds the amount obtained by multiplying the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets in the formula of Article 2, each item (in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the total of the amount set forth in Article 128, item (ii) and the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets relating to securitization exposures) by 1.25%, such multiplied amount shall apply). (b) In the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount obtained by deducting the total amount of expected loss amounts relating to exposures to corporates, etc. and retail exposures from the total amount of eligible allowances, where such total eligible allowances exceed such total expected loss amounts (where such amount exceeds the amount obtained by multiplying the amount set forth in Article 128, item (i) by 0.6%, such multiplied amount shall apply).
